author: Chicago City Wire
title: Scott H. Kozin named chief medical officer of Shriners Children's healthcare system
text:
Scott H. Kozin, M.D., has been appointed as the new chief medical officer for Shriners Children’s healthcare system after three decades of service in patient care. In his new role, Dr. Kozin will oversee physicians and advanced practice practitioners across all Shriners Children’s facilities in North America. He is expected to transition away from direct patient care during the first half of 2026.
Dr. Kozin’s colleagues at Shriners Children’s Philadelphia, including Dan A. Zlotolow, M.D., Eugene Park, M.D., physician assistants, and the rehabilitation team, will continue to provide care for patients. The hospital stated that these professionals have worked closely with Dr. Kozin for many years and are prepared to maintain the standard of care established under his leadership.
Reflecting on his career at Shriners Children’s Philadelphia, Dr. Kozin said the past 30 years have been a “labor of love.” He added that he has enjoyed caring for children and working as a hand surgeon in an environment focused on doing what is right for each child.
Shriners Children’s expressed gratitude for Dr. Kozin’s years of service and highlighted his upcoming responsibilities leading the Shriners Children’s Medical Group to enhance pediatric care throughout North America—including the United States, Mexico, Canada—and through its expanding international program.
Patients or families with questions about transferring care or future appointments are encouraged to contact the patient access department at 215-430-4073 or use their MyChart account messaging feature. Well-wishes can be sent via email to phlpatientrelations@shrinenet.org.
The organization thanked families for choosing Shriners Children’s and acknowledged the importance of providing care for their children.
